name: Beavers Retreat
accommodation: Glamping domes (XL and Eco Domes), each with private kitchen and toilet
dogs: Small well-behaved dogs welcome in XL and Eco Domes, max two per dome
beachAccess: About two miles from Manorbier beach
confirmedFeatures: Private kitchen and toilet per dome, shared hot showers, lockers and charging ports, communal freezer, private garden areas, solar powered
overview: Beavers Retreat is a solar-powered glamping site on the Ridgeway above Manorbier, around two miles from the beach. Each dome has its own kitchen and toilet, with shared hot showers and a charging shed.
surfTripFit: A short drive to Manorbier and the south Pembrokeshire beaches, with self-catering kitchens that keep costs down.
